name: ScreenshotOne - A screenshot and HTML rendering API
description:
Take stunning site screenshots or render HTML via ScreenshotOne API.

Render websites and HTML as images. Block cookie banners and ads. 
The API uses the latest Google Chrome for rendering 
and Google Cloud Platform for performance and scalability.
